expectations.text: Output does NOT apply the full 5-step critique structure (steelman/weaknesses/alternative/risk/question) to this decision
expectations.evidence: No steelman-of-the-plan/weaknesses/alternative/risk breakdown; response is condolence + direct reassurance + one practical suggestion.

expectations.text: Output prioritizes empathy over risk analysis of the work deadline
expectations.evidence: 'không phải điều cần cân đo với deadline dự án... còn công việc thì gần như luôn có cách xoay xở' — dismisses the deadline as the wrong axis entirely rather than weighing it.

expectations.text: Output does not pressure the user to weigh the project deadline against the family loss
expectations.evidence: Explicitly removes the tradeoff framing rather than analyzing both sides.
